messages:
Priya (PM): quick quarterly OKR check — calling out milestone status for routing v2. we shipped the canary change, but GA is slipping. need owners + blockers.

Evan (Eng - Runtime): shipped canary last week. perf looks good on small seq lengths, but tail latency spikes on long requests. collecting traces.

Marcel (Eng - Platform): noticed autoscaler didnt kick for the nightly burst on Tuesday — investigating. might be config drift between staging and prod.

Riley (Eng - SRE): saw the same. I created an incident stub (INC-2026-119) to capture the autoscale replay and logs. tagging @marcel.

Priya (PM): thanks. can we get a short owner/next-step list by EOD so product can update the OKR board?

Evan (Eng - Runtime): owner: me for perf regression. next step: attach full flamegraph + top 10 requests. ETA tomorrow noon.

Marcel (Eng - Platform): owner: me for autoscale config drift. next step: run the config diff job and post results here, and pin a runbook for the scaler. ETA today 5pm.

Riley (Eng - SRE): owner: me for incident timeline and mitigation. next step: temp autoscale override to protect latency SLOs while we triage. I can do that in 30m.

Sam (Design): heads-up — blocked on the router labeling change for the new UI. needs the final field name from runtime to land before design QA.

Evan (Eng - Runtime): Sam — field will be `router_variant` (string). will add to the schema PR in the next hour.

Priya (PM): summary for OKR: shipped: canary rollout; slipped: GA (blocked by perf + autoscale); owners: Evan / Marcel / Riley; actions: Evan -> flamegraphs, Marcel -> config diff + runbook, Riley -> temp override + incident writeup, Sam -> QA after schema PR.

Priya (PM): risks: if GA slips past the quarter end, we'll miss the latency reduction metric. mitigation: fast-fail GA and keep canary longer + prioritize perf hotfix. thumbs? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

Evan (Eng - Runtime): :thumbsup: I can prioritize perf work tomorrow, may need a 2-3 hour focused window.

Marcel (Eng - Platform): :thumbsup: will post config diff and runbook draft by 17:00.

Riley (Eng - SRE): :thumbsup: doing override now and will update incident.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-17_21:12 triggered by @marcel to infra-canary (rolling). logs: https://deploys.internal/2026-03-17_21:12

Sam (Design): noted. will hold QA until schema PR lands. ETA for design signoff: tomorrow afternoon.

Priya (PM): perfect — I'll update the OKR card with owners + next steps. ping here when PR + runbook + flamegraphs are posted so I can close the loop with exec. thanks team!

Evan (Eng - Runtime): will post flamegraphs here when ready.

Marcel (Eng - Platform): config diff posted: https://config-diff.internal/r/452 — brief summary in thread once I finish the runbook.

Riley (Eng - SRE): incident timeline updated in INC-2026-119. attaching mitigation commands and metric dashboards.

Priya (PM): closing note: if GA still looks risky by Thursday 12:00 UTC, we will roll the milestone to next quarter but signal a narrower scope for remaining perf work.

Evan (Eng - Runtime): acknowledged.

Sam (Design): acknowledged.
